shares dropped ~24% in Thursday afternoon trading after a cancer news website earlier in the day released eagerly anticipated results for the company's personalized cancer vaccine, intismeran autogene, which is under development with Merck
That data was slated for release on Oct. 24 at the European Society for Medical Oncology Congress in Madrid.
Before they were taken down by Oncology Central, data showed that intismeran autogene plus Keytruda (pembrolizumab) cut the risk of melanoma returning or death by 42% vs. Keytruda alone.
And at two years, 82.2% of those on the combo were alive compared to 70% of those just on Keytruda.

title: Moderna shares plunge on leaked cancer vaccine data
